title: Categories & units
intro: The two lists every stall picks from when it adds a product. Categories are yours to set. Units are yours to curate, but a stall can always name its own when nothing here fits.

categoryForm.title: Add a category
categoryForm.name: Name
categoryForm.nameHint: In English, sentence case. Hand-lettered on a product tag that has no photo.

unitNote.title: Two of these units were typed by a stall, not by you.
unitNote.text: A stall names its own unit when nothing in the picker fits. Promote the ones that catch on, merge the duplicates, and leave the rest alone.

unitsNote: A unit is kept as text on the product, so a stall is never blocked by this list. What you curate here is what appears in the picker, and which spellings get merged so reports do not split “bag” from “Bag”.

unitForm.title: Add a unit
unitForm.manyHint: English has no rule for this, so it is typed rather than guessed.

removeCategory.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeCategory.textUsed_one: {{count}} product uses it. Choose where it goes.
removeCategory.textUsed_other: {{count}} products use it. Choose where they go.

mergeUnit.title: Merge {{name}} into another unit?
mergeUnit.text: Products using it are rewritten to the unit you choose, and past orders keep the unit they were sold under.

categories.title: No categories yet
categories.text: Add a category and Farmers can file their products under it.

toast.categoryAdded: Category added. Stalls can pick it now.
toast.promoted: {{name}} is now in the picker for every stall.
